{{Quote|I don't know where you get your delusions, laserbrain.|Princess Leia to Han Solo|<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
"'''Laserbrain''',"<ref name="EBS junior">[[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back (junior novelization)|''Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back'' junior novelization]]</ref> also spelled as "'''laser brain'''"<ref name="Droids 6">[[Droids (1995) 6|''Droids'' (1995) 6]]</ref> and "'''laser-brain'''",<ref name="Underworld 3">[[Underworld: The Yavin Vassilika 3|''Underworld: The Yavin Vassilika'' 3]]</ref> was an insult used in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="ESB" /> Notable users of this term included [[Kendara Farlion]],<ref name="Shadow Games">''[[Shadow Games]]''</ref> [[Steggus]],<ref name="Droids 6">[[Droids (1995) 6|''Droids'' (1995) 6]]</ref> [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]],<ref name="Underworld 3" /> [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo|Leia]],<ref name="ESB" /> her husband [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]],<ref name="Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref> and their daughter [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]].<ref name="Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref>

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The word "laserbrain" first appeared in the [[1980]] film {{Film|V}}. The word<ref name="ESB" /> is similar to the real-world insult "birdbrain."<ref name="Birdbrain">{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/birdbrain|text=birdbrain|quote=a stupid person|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20250214064412}}</ref>
